digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC transport test harness
propositions: Test derives rename target by replacing final character with 'Z', causing collision when source key already ends in 'Z' (~1 in 26 probability)
Collision is not a product defect but a flaw in test setup derivation; failure rate depends entirely on random project key generation
Collision was caught by setup assertion checking new_project_key != jira_dc_project, preventing silent rename of project to identical key
Fix must derive collision-free target by conditional character replacement (Z→Y, or other approach) rather than unconditional substitution
Fixed derivation must satisfy Jira project-key constraints (uppercase letters, length 2-10) and be proven by unit test covering all 26 possible final letters
